target: Determine M(7) exactly: construct a non-classical set of three mutually orthogonal quantum Latin squares of order 7, or prove no such set exists (unrestricted arbitrary complex entries).

primary_attestation.source: Ball–Simoens arXiv:2607.12933v2 (2026-07-27), Definition M(n) LF29–31, Table2 LF77–80, §2.2–2.3 LF90–116 in the pinned layout text
primary_attestation.definition_quote: we define M(n) as the largest value of t such that a non-classical set of t MOQLS(n) exist
primary_attestation.baseline: Table2 gives 2 <= M(7) <= 4. This run proved every 4 MOQLS(7) set classical, hence 2 <= M(7) <= 3 (review/moqls7-parent-verdict.md). M(7) is NOT the largest size without the non-classical requirement; that broader value can be 6 for classical MOLS(7).
primary_attestation.further_open_case: Han et al. arXiv:2507.20154v1 Thm3.8 lists v=7 among the remaining exceptions for non-classical 3-MOQLS; Huang–Li arXiv:2606.27758v1 lists MCPQLS(7) unresolved (a sufficient, not equivalent search route).
primary_attestation.pre_freeze_screen: screening/phys-next-screen-v3.md; NONE-FOUND-IN-SCOPE for an earlier non-classical triple / exactM7 result. DataCite/Zenodo/OpenAlex/arXiv checks have access/index gaps; repeat after any result. The scout local-path citation proof/PROOF_PARTIAL.md is corrected to moqls7-problem16/review/PROOF_PARTIAL.md; that is a historical 4-square partial note, not a present open Problem16 case.

exact_object.squares: Three 7x7 arrays Q_s of unit vectors in C^7. Every row and column of each is an orthonormal basis. For each s != t the49 vectors Q_s(i,j) tensor Q_t(i,j) form an orthonormal basis of C^49.
exact_object.non_classical: At least ONE square has more than7 distinct projective rays (classicality is up to entry phases, common row/column permutations, independent unitary per square as in source§2.3). It is NOT required that all3 squares are non-classical.
exact_object.positive_certificate: All147 vectors in an exact algebraic-number representation, explicit exact row/column/tensor-ONB and ray-count verification. A numerical optimizer or SAT support pattern alone is not a witness.
exact_object.negative_scope: No non-classical set of3 for arbitrary complex vectors. A full reduction and certified exclusion must cover exactly1,2,3 non-classical squares; classification imports and all normalization/symmetry steps reviewed.
exact_object.implied_maximum: With accepted M7<=3, any positive triple provesM7=3; an unrestricted negative provesM7=2 using the published non-classical pair lower bound.
